patches.name: Allow Gearslip
patches.description: Lets Gearslip, the Android Auto alternative, show Waze on the car screen. Waze's car library accepts only Android Auto itself on a phone; this adds Gearslip (and any other host you list) to the hosts it accepts. Android Auto keeps working as before.

options.title: Accepted hosts
options.description: digest,package entries separated by ';'. The digest is the SHA-256 of the host's signing certificate, 64 lowercase hex characters (apksigner verify --print-certs), or * for any certificate.
